study: input-conditioned dynamic layer gate on one frozen E03_s42 LoRA cache

architecture.gate: per-sample additive attention over independently projected layer values
architecture.direct_path: layer-32 projection plus 1e-3 identity-initialized fusion residual

training.checkpoint_selection: minimum validation BCE independently per arm and seed
training.threshold_selection: primary decision threshold pre-registered at 0.5; validation accuracy optimum is sensitivity analysis only
training.calibration: none in this diagnostic; use out-of-fold calibration before changing the primary threshold

primary_estimand: dynamic_fixed/dynamic_selected minus dynamic_repeat_last under identical capacity, initialization, batch order, dropout stream, frozen features, and validation rules
limitations: The frozen adapter was trained jointly with an E03 final-layer head.
Head seeds are not independent LoRA seeds.
The source test split has already been explored; this is a post-hoc diagnostic.
The selected-layer arm reuses a validation-driven exploratory layer selection.
The primary threshold is fixed at 0.5; no out-of-fold calibration is fitted in this diagnostic.
Per-source and gate-weight analyses are descriptive and unadjusted for multiplicity.
